Name: Sal
Description: After the Punisher burned the Bar With No Name during Stilt-Man 's wake, Sal re-opened it and with a group of small time criminals, managed to acquire Stilt-Man's suit thanks to the Tinkerer. The want to form a Stilt-Man crew. Sal acquired the bar on the logical basis that the Punisher would not burn the place to the ground twice in a row and that no criminals would dare coming back in here after Castle's last visit.
